entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.comment: This reduced rate applies only to occupational therapy and movement therapy equipment: balloons (for breathing function training), mega-balls, active balls, sitting balls, balls for the therapy of seniors and functional balls for rehab. of sick or disabled person; 9506 62 00 — reflex balls and gravity balls, int. for rehab. of sick or disabled persons, 9506 69 90 —physioth. rollers, functional pillows for physiotherapy and back stretching benches; 9506 91 90 — rings for occup. th.; 9506 99 90
